environment.description: ECS Fargate service running behind an Application Load Balancer with TLS termination. The /oauth/authorize/complete endpoint is publicly accessible on port 443. Kafka topic 'oauth-authorization-requests' accepts messages from any authenticated producer in the VPC. No additional URL validation or request signing is applied at the infrastructure layer. ALB forwards all requests matching path pattern /oauth/* to the target group.

config.kafka: MSK cluster, SASL/SCRAM auth, any VPC producer can publish
